title: Board displays an ["inspect", story_choice_id] action tuple but… @ albany_city
excerpts: Board displays an ["inspect", story_choice_id] action tuple but inspect_overworld_session_story rejects that literal tuple; only the bare id string works.
Passing 'inspect' as story_choice_id (misreading the ['inspect', id] tuple) gives an unhelpful generic rejection instead of guidance.
